in_marathi.name: Ojaswin
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Vigor, Energy, Life Force
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ojaswin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ojaswin is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ojas' meaning 'vigor, energy, life force' and 'aswin' meaning 'horse'. In Hindu mythology, the Ashwin twins are the gods of horses and healing. This name symbolizes the power of vitality and strength, and the recipient is believed to be blessed with the ability to overcome obstacles and thrive.
